correctness.rationale: All derivations are block triangular because the full labeled edge tensor basis forces cross-part blocks to vanish for a,b>=2. Idempotence is equivalent to A,B projections, 2A⊗B=0, and the explicitly solved shear equation SΦ+ΦT=Φ. The Gaussian coefficient times complement count and shear eigenspace dimension give the exact operator rank polynomial. For fixed q, odd-characteristic weights have a quadratic exponent maximized near 3n/4; even-characteristic all-identity projections provide q^{2n^3} rank-2n examples while every competing projection-rank pair loses at least n^2/2 in the q-exponent (n>=4), giving exponential concentration. An independent finite-field computation solves shear equations by elimination and reproduces complete rank histograms for (2,2,q) q=2,3,5 and (2,3,2); output VERIFY_OK. These finite tests are not used as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The complete rank polynomial, including all nongraded central-shear derivations, and the sharp fixed-field odd-versus-even characteristic asymptotics were not obtained in the inspected sources. Godoy Molina–Lagos construct the exact graph-Lie family and calculate graded derivations in characteristic other than two (arXiv:2308.00272, §§2,5.2) but do not solve projection idempotency or count operator ranks. Burde–Moens (arXiv:2009.05434) study polynomial-identity derivations through nilpotency constraints. Eick–Moede (arXiv:2205.03155, §2) treat inner idempotents and simple characteristic-two Lie algebras. Related prior rank spectra for filiform Lie algebras have distinct domains. Existing relevant records and exact/alias searches did not identify stronger numerical coverage. This is provisional bibliographical originality, not proof of global uniqueness.

value.rationale: Operator rank is a natural intrinsic invariant of individual derivations, and the exact finite-field polynomial describes all its multiplicities in an infinite graph-Lie family rather than just grading existence or derivation-space dimension. The proven dichotomy changes the typical normalized operator rank from 3/4 in every odd characteristic to zero in characteristic two, with explicit exponential error; this is a structural asymptotic consequence of how the two tensor projection eigenspaces interact. It is mathematically motivated by characteristic-sensitive derivation and grading theory, and not a routine special-case numerical recomputation.
